definitions.gloss: to be cooked; to be done (of rice)
definitions.explanation: Of rice or other grains: to finish cooking. The intransitive partner of {炊|た}く, used with the rice itself as subject.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{炊|た}けた。
⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{炊|た}ける⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: Wait a little until the rice is cooked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スイッチ→スイッチ：03848_suicchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧、⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧になって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{炊|た}けて⟦いなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to switch on the rice cooker, so even by evening the rice wasn't cooked.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{炊|た}ける. The transitive partner is ⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧ (⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧, "to cook rice").

USAGE:
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{炊|た}けた⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧: "the rice is ready", a common call to the table.
- {炊|た}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the finished result: the rice is cooked and waiting.
- Rice cookers announce the end with ⟦{炊|た}き{上|あ}がり→炊き上がる：21619_takiagaru⟧ (done cooking).

WATCH OUT:
⟦{長|た}ける→長ける：14540_takeru⟧ (to excel at) has the same reading but is a different word.
